item.title: Playhead 0.1.0 (build 12)
item.description:
**Player** - No volume control in the player on any device. Use the device's own volume; M still mutes on a keyboard. - TV: Left/Right reach every button in the bottom row (the volume slider was catching them). - Seeking: the focus ring sits on the seek dot. - The Back button in the player leaves it right away.
**Resume** - Continue Watching, Up Next and history now open the exact episode and start playing from where you stopped. - The page underneath no longer steals the remote from the player.
Windows stays on build 6 for this test release.
